Parses closed actual ThreatId before profile lookup, preserves full requested actor ID, computes scaling through separate canonical bounded-word helper and uses actual static CombatProfile. It builds attributes/skills from same rating, installs mode-specific weapon, immutable innate/armored profile and same ranged ammo/initial_ammunition12. Fixed static profile precision/mass/training ranges are real lower predicates; no hypothetical arbitrary raw MAX profile can reach private threat_weapon from this public string API. Scaling and difficulty are native finite integers, not arbitrary f32 endpoints. Exact lower scaler/current bestiary bodies remain independently scoped.

Current producer roles873/874 copy same timing and batch references, raw missing-payload behavior in consumers remains separate. with_terminal simply adds resolution; used normally with Terminal kind, not a generic whole-event gate.
